title.rendered: Manchester City Kit 2025 – 2026 Dream League Soccer 2026

content.rendered:
Import or Copy URL of Manchester City Kit 2025 – 2026 for Dream League Soccer 2026 (DLS) game for Android, which changes the overall appearance of your team, this kit can also be imported into any latest FTS – First Touch Soccer game for Android.

When building your team, You will need jersey’s, that is why you are getting Manchester City DLS kit for season 2025/2026 and Logo below, to fully customize the appearance of your players.

Home DLS Kit Manchester City 25/26
